items.title: Why Is Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) Powering A New U.S. AI Factory?
items.summary: Advanced Micro Devices (NasdaqGS:AMD) hardware now powers the Lux SI + HPC supercomputer at Oak Ridge National Laboratory. Lux is described as the first dedicated U.S. AI Factory for the Department of Energy's Genesis Mission. The system combines AMD EPYC CPUs, Instinct GPUs, Pensando networking, and ROCm software in a single AI and HPC platform. The Lux SI + HPC deployment for the Genesis Mission gives AMD new visibility in U.S. government scale AI infrastructure, but the wider AMD story...
